in_marathi.name: Shyamsundar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of the Moon
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shyamsundar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Shyamsundar is a combination of two words: Shyam and Sundar. Shyam means 'dark' or 'god of the night', and Sundar means 'beautiful' or 'handsome'. So, Shyamsundar can be interpreted as 'God of the Beautiful Moon'.
